_SCHEMA_VERSION: university_schema_v8 — updated 2026-04-02. _id = fp2 (readable string, not ObjectId). name_normalized DEPRECATED → use nameClean. All enum values lowercase. public_or_private REMOVED → use campus_type.ownership. source_tier description aligned with Core Rules v8. admission_type gains round_based. culinary_skills typo fixed.
_SCORING_NOTE: data_completeness_score is computed by pipeline using weighted field registry. Identity fields (name, country, state, city, institution_type, website) have weight 4-5. Student-decision fields (tuition, rankings, intakes, scholarships) have weight 2-4. See CORE_RULES.md Section on Completeness Scoring for full registry.

_id.description: Primary key. Always identical to fp2. Format: '{countryCode3_lower}|{state_normalized}|{city_normalized}|{nameClean}'. e.g. 'usa|massachusetts|cambridge|harvard university'. Set explicitly by pipeline — NOT MongoDB auto-generated ObjectId. Collision = exact duplicate → merge only. Changes if state/city is corrected — expected and correct.

name.description: Full official university name in English. Never abbreviated. Primary display field. min_length=2. Proper case for display (e.g. 'Harvard University', not 'harvard university').

name_original.description: Native script name. e.g. Cyrillic, Arabic, CJK. Null for English-only institutions. Stored for traceability when name was translated.

name_normalized.description: DEPRECATED — use nameClean (top-level). Kept for backward compatibility only. Do not write new data to this field. Lowercase ASCII-transliterated name, stop-words removed.

institution_type.description: Institution category. ALL values lowercase. Use most specific applicable value. 'university_system' = multi-campus system record (e.g. University of California system). Programs NEVER attach to university_system records — only to individual campus records.

slug.description: URL-safe kebab-case identifier. e.g. 'harvard-university'. Generated once, never changed.

website.description: Official university website. Must start with https://. Never a third-party URL. Null when institution has no web presence — common for small colleges. When null, fp1 is also null and Layer 5 (AI semantic sweep) provides dedup coverage.

phone.description: Contact phone with country code. e.g. '+1 617 495 1000'.

description.description: General institutional overview. Plain text, no HTML.

affiliated_university.description: Parent or partner institution name if applicable. For affiliated colleges, also set parent_university_id.

medium_of_instruction.description: Primary language(s) of teaching. e.g. 'English' or 'Ukrainian, English'.

logo_url.description: Public URL for university logo image.

university_aliases.description: Short names, acronyms, variant spellings, and pre-translation names. Used for search matching. e.g. ['KNU', 'Taras Shevchenko University']. Merged across sources with $addToSet.

university_vector_context.description: ML semantic search context string. Written by ML pipeline only. Never overwrite from scraper.

location.description: Array with single location object. All geo data lives here.

city.description: City name in English. From city alias map — canonical name only. Proper case for display.

state.description: State/province name in English. Full name, never abbreviated ('California' not 'CA'). Proper case for display.

country.description: Country full name in English. e.g. 'United States', not 'UA' or 'USA'.

geonames_id.description: GeoNames numeric ID for this location.

country_id.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. e.g. 'IN', 'US', 'UA'. max_length=2.

state_id.description: GeoNames ID or slug linking to states collection.

city_id.description: GeoNames ID or slug linking to cities collection.

country_vector_context.description: ML semantic string for country. Written by ML pipeline only.

country_aliasing_vector.description: 1536-dim embedding vector. Written by ML pipeline only.

ownership.description: Ownership model. ALL values lowercase. 'government_aided' = private institution receiving govt funding. This is the primary ownership field — legacy public_or_private has been removed.

delivery_mode.description: Primary mode of study offered. ALL values lowercase.

tuition_domestic.description: Annual domestic/in-state tuition in native currency. University-level default — program.program_fees_domestic overrides per program.

tuition_international.description: Annual international tuition in native currency. University-level default.

tuition_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for tuition fields. e.g. 'USD', 'GBP', 'AUD'. Always uppercase ISO code.

tuition_domestic_usd.description: Annual domestic tuition converted to USD. Auto-computed by pipeline.

tuition_international_usd.description: Annual international tuition converted to USD. Auto-computed by pipeline.

room_and_board.description: Annual room and board cost in native currency.

net_price.description: Average net price after financial aid in native currency.

financial_aid_pct.description: Percentage of students receiving any financial aid. e.g. 0.65 = 65%.

status.description: Current operational status. ALL values lowercase.

accreditation.description: Accreditation records. Critical for visa eligibility checks.

type.description: Scope of accreditation. ALL values lowercase.

accredited_since.description: Year accreditation was first granted. Format: YYYY.

valid_until.description: Expiry year. Format: YYYY. Null means indefinite or ongoing.

programmes.description: Array of program fp2 string refs (matching program _id). Managed by program pipeline. Do not write from scraper.

all_programmes_list.description: Grouped list of program names by degree type. Convenience field for display.

other.description: Any program type not covered above — associate, vocational, professional etc.

acceptance_rate.description: Overall acceptance rate as decimal string. e.g. '0.145' = 14.5%.

international_acceptance_rate.description: Acceptance rate for international applicants. e.g. '10-20%'.

admission_type.description: University-wide admissions pattern. ALL values lowercase. round_based added in v8.

application_deadline.description: Default deadline. Format: 'DD MM YYYY'. Use 'rolling' for rolling admissions.

application_opening_date.description: Date applications open. Format: 'DD MM YYYY'.

application_fee.description: Application fee in native currency for domestic students.

application_fee_usd.description: Application fee converted to USD. Auto-computed.

program_dates_independent.description: False = all programs share university-level dates. True = each program has its own dates. Default: false.

available_intakes.description: Intake seasons. ALL values lowercase. fall = Aug-Sep, spring = Jan-Feb, summer = May-Jun, winter = Dec.

standardized_test_policy.description: University-wide standardized test policy. ALL values lowercase.

visa_required.description: Whether a student visa is required for international applicants.

language_test_required.description: Whether a language test is required at university level.

language_test_waiver_conditions.description: Conditions under which language test is waived.

qualifying_test_waiver.description: Conditions under which subject/qualifying tests are waived.

application_fee.description: Application fee for international students in native currency.

application_fee_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for international application fee.

application_fee_usd.description: International application fee converted to USD.

general_eligibility.description: General eligibility note for international applicants.

other_conditions.description: Remaining university-level conditions for international students.

standardized_test_policy.description: Override for international applicants only. Null when same as university-wide policy. ALL values lowercase.

special_quota_countries.description: Country-specific or bloc-specific quota arrangements. Key is country/bloc name.

quota_type.description: Nature of the quota. ALL values lowercase.

seats_reserved.description: Seats reserved. e.g. '5% of total intake'.

fee_structure.description: Which fee structure applies. ALL values lowercase.

employment_rate.description: Percentage in work/study 6-15 months after graduation.

median_earnings_after_3_years.description: Median earnings 3 years post-graduation in native currency.

median_earnings_after_5_years.description: Median earnings 5 years post-graduation in native currency.

median_earnings_after_6_years.description: Median salary 6 years post-graduation in native currency.

median_earnings_after_6_years_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for median earnings.

avg_salary.description: Average graduate salary in native currency.

summer_start_date.description: Typical start of summer/fall semester. Format: 'DD MM YYYY'.

winter_start_date.description: Typical start of winter/spring semester. Format: 'DD MM YYYY'.

phd_students.description: Count of PhD or doctoral students.

vocational_students.description: Count of vocational or diploma students.

average_per_year.description: Total estimated living cost per year in native currency.

average_per_year_usd.description: Living cost per year converted to USD.

on_campus_accommodation.description: University housing cost per year in native currency.

qs_world.description: QS World rank. Exact number or range. e.g. '42' or '101-150'.

qs_world_year.description: Year of QS ranking. Format: YYYY.

qs_world_date.description: Same as qs_world_year. Write same value to both.

times_year.description: Year of THE ranking. Format: YYYY.

times_date.description: Same as times_year. Write same value to both.

other_rankings.description: Name of ONE additional ranking source.

other_rankings_year.description: Year of other ranking. Format: YYYY.

scholarship_details.description: Overview of scholarships and financial aid.

climate.description: Weather description for the city or region.

university_application_response_time_in_.description: Average admission decision turnaround in weeks.

location_type.description: Campus location type. ALL values lowercase.

sources.description: Single source of truth for all source attribution, freshness, and captured data. One entry per portal/source. Min 1 entry required at lock time.

source.description: External registry or source name (uppercase). e.g. 'ROR', 'WHED', 'IPEDS'.

source_tier.description: Source Priority Ladder tier (1-5). 1=University own website (ground truth). 2=Visa/Accreditation portals (binary facts — DEQAR, CRICOS, NAAC). 3=Top global/national rankings ONLY (QS, THE, ARWU, CWUR). 4=Government education portals (IPEDS, UCAS, PDDikti). 5=Aggregators (StudyPortals, UniPage, ApplyBoard — fill empty slots, replaceable by higher tiers). RULE: Empty slot → any tier can fill. Occupied slot → only lower tier number overwrites.

source_id.description: ID in that external source. e.g. ROR ID, WHED ID, AISHE code.

source_url.description: Exact URL scraped for this record.

scraped_at.description: When WE scraped this data. ISO 8601.

source_data_date.description: When the SOURCE last updated their data. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

data_age_days.description: How old the source data is in days. Auto-computed.

external_ids_from_this_source.description: External IDs this source provided. e.g. {'aishe_code': 'U-0335'}.

source_captured_data.description: ALL fields from this source as flat dict. Schema fields use dot-path keys (e.g. 'basic_info.name': 'Harvard'). Non-schema fields use raw field name. RULE: Nothing from the source should be lost. Append-only — never delete or modify.

parent_university_id.description: For affiliated colleges: fp2 string (_id) of parent university. e.g. 'ind|delhi|new delhi|university of delhi'. For EC6 cross-border campuses: fp2 of main campus. Null for independent institutions.

parent_university_name.description: Human-readable parent university name. Denormalized for display.

last_updated.description: Last update timestamp. Written by system pipeline.

domain_fingerprint.description: Root domain for dedup (domainClean). e.g. 'harvard.edu'. Root domain + TLD only — all subdomains stripped.

merge_history.description: Records merged into this one. Format: 'canonicalName|reason|layer'.

confidence_score.description: Confidence in record accuracy. 0.0 to 1.0. Default: 0.0.

last_seen_at.description: Per-source last-seen timestamps. Key = source name, value = ISO 8601 datetime. Updated every time a portal refreshes this record.

field_source.description: Tracks which source provided each field value. Key = dot-path field, value = {source, tier}. e.g. {'basic_info.name': {'source': 'IPEDS', 'tier': 4}}.

discovered_via.description: How this university was discovered. 'university_portal' = found in portal_*_universities. 'program_portal' = discovered during program ingestion as an orphan. Null for pre-existing records.

original_language.description: ISO 639-1 language code of source data. e.g. 'en', 'uk', 'zh'. Default: 'en'.

translated.description: True if AI was used to translate fields to English. Default: false.

data_completeness_score.description: Weighted completeness score 0.0-1.0. Computed by pipeline using weighted field registry from CORE_RULES.md.

data_completeness.description: stub = score < 0.3 | partial = 0.3-0.7 | complete = score > 0.7. ALL values lowercase.

_IDENTITY_FIELDS_NOTE: Fields below are the university identity layer — used for fast lookup, cross-portal dedup, and cross-referencing.

countryCode3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code lowercase. e.g. 'usa', 'ind', 'gbr'. Must match basic_info.location[0].country_id equivalent.

nameClean.description: Output of clean_string(basic_info.name). Lowercase, ASCII-normalized, no punctuation. e.g. 'harvard university'. Used as dedup token in fp1/fp2. Recomputed after every standardization pass. See CORE_RULES.md Section 4 for clean_string() spec.

fp1.description: Domain-based fingerprint. Format: '{countryCode3}|{domainClean}|{nameClean}'. e.g. 'usa|harvard.edu|harvard university'. Null when no domain. Immutable after creation. Unique sparse index.

fp2.description: Geo-based fingerprint = _id = primary dedup key. Format: '{countryCode3}|{state_normalized_lower}|{city_normalized_lower}|{nameClean}'. e.g. 'usa|massachusetts|cambridge|harvard university'. Computed AFTER all normalization (city alias, state expansion, clean_string). All segments lowercase.

oldIds.description: Source-prefixed IDs for cross-reference. Format: '{source}:{id}'. e.g. ['ipeds:166027', 'ror:05tby3y60', 'whed:IAU-007039']. Derived from sources[].source_id.

_REMOVED_FIELDS_NOTE: public_or_private REMOVED in v8 — use campus_type.ownership. name_normalized DEPRECATED — use nameClean.
_SCHEMA_CHANGES_v8: 1. _id changed from ObjectId to string fp2. 2. name_normalized deprecated. 3. source_tier description aligned with Core Rules. 4. All enum values lowercase. 5. public_or_private removed. 6. culinary_skills typo fixed. 7. admission_type gains round_based. 8. institution_type gains university_system. 9. sources[].source_captured_data is flat dict (consistent format). 10. parent_university_id changed from ObjectId to string fp2. 11. academics.programmes changed from List[ObjectId] to List[str] (fp2 refs). 12. dedup_meta.discovered_via added. 13. dedup_meta.last_seen_at made required. 14. dedup_meta.field_source value format changed to {source, tier} dict.
